goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: The Veteran preference-ranked option and the access-standard comparator can differ because preferences rank only already-eligible options, while the comparator remains the earliest eligible VA option used for the wait-standard calculation.

story: For DEMO-CARD-5000335-001, explain which option ranks first for preference and which option is the access-standard comparator, and why they may differ.
starting_sentence: For case DEMO-CARD-5000335-001, which option ranks first for the Veteran's preference, and which option is the access-standard comparator? Explain why they are allowed to differ.
